mapper.select:
SELECT ID, TOOL_CODE, TOOL_NAME, TOOL_TYPE, CABINET_NO, STATUS, SPECIFICATION, IMAGE_URL, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME FROM TOOL_INFO
AND (TOOL_CODE like '%'||#{keyword}||'%' OR TOOL_NAME like '%'||#{keyword}||'%')
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT ID, TOOL_CODE, TOOL_NAME, TOOL_TYPE, CABINET_NO, STATUS, SPECIFICATION, IMAGE_URL, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME FROM TOOL_INFO WHERE STATUS = 'AVAILABLE'
AND (TOOL_CODE like '%'||#{keyword}||'%' OR TOOL_NAME like '%'||#{keyword}||'%')
AND TOOL_TYPE = #{toolType}
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TOOL_INFO (ID, TOOL_CODE, TOOL_NAME, TOOL_TYPE, CABINET_NO, STATUS, SPECIFICATION, IMAGE_URL, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (TOOL_INFO_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{toolCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toolName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toolType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cabinetNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{specification, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TOOL_INFO WHERE TOOL_CODE = #{toolCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
